      "rationale": "Resolves data races in getblockheader and getchaintxstats by locking cs_main when reading block index transaction counts.     },

      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Annotates CBlockIndex fields with GUARDED_BY(cs_main) in src/chain.h and enforces locking in src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Enforces cs_main thread-safety invariants on CBlockIndex::nTx and m_chain_tx_count across validation and snapshot dumping. CBlockIndex fields are written under cs_main during block processing and AssumeUTXO sync, so adding compile-time Clang thread safety annotations eliminates concurrency hazards and prevents data races."
